text:
The court will most likely declare the statute constitutional, with no equal protection violation. The 20% threshold is an objective line, and the 7% petition for non-party candidates is a modest showing of support that courts have upheld (*Jenness v. Fortson*, 5%; *Storer v. Brown*). The 180-day circulation period matches the party deadline, so the burden is comparable, though the 7% figure is the most exposed element.

CONFIDENCE: 68
